name: Camping 3
desc:
Welcome to your next Camping trip! Accompanied by Park Ranger Daniel and Park Ranger Steve, you'll be staying at Wicka Peak. Just make sure you've packed plenty of winter clothing because it's freezing cold at the mountain! Enjoy sightseeing with friends, or stay in the cozy lodge by the warm fireplace! Hope you have a great time!

This game was built and scripted by SamsonXVI. It is also the sequel to the good ending in Camping 2!
